extracted.intended_audience: academics, peer reviewers, faculty administrators, and researchers interested in academic evaluation and peer review processes
extracted.subtask_description: Extracting criteria and evaluative dimensions used by professors when judging quality in peer review, hiring, promotion, and related academic evaluations; the book analyzes how judgments are made across disciplines and countries. Useful for people designing or studying peer review, tenure/hire panels, and evaluation policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judgment is emotional, cognitive, and social
rubrics_metrics.description: "Judging quality isn't robotically rational; it's emotional, cognitive, and social, too."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluators should acknowledge that assessments are influenced by emotions, cognitive heuristics, and social context rather than assuming purely mechanistic objectivity; include self-awareness of these influences when making decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analyze complexity to recognize quality and pursue fairness
rubrics_metrics.description: Most academics' self-respect is rooted in their ability to analyze complexity and recognize quality, in order to come to the fairest decisions about that elusive god, 'excellence.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessment should engage with the complexity of candidates' work (multiple dimensions of quality) and seek to reach fair decisions rather than relying on simplistic or single-metric judgments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gatekeepers must understand and perform their role responsibly
rubrics_metrics.description: Lamont aims to illuminate the confidential process of evaluation and to push the gatekeepers to both better understand and perform their role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Those who serve on review/hiring/tenure panels should reflect on their responsibilities, improve understanding of the evaluation process, and adopt practices that enhance legitimacy and fairness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand panel dynamics and 'opening the black box' of peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of contents item: 'Opening the black box of peer review -- How panels work' (focus on confidential processes and panel functioning).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that panel outcomes are shaped by deliberation, interpersonal dynamics, confidentiality, and procedural arrangements; design and participate in panels with attention to these mechanisms (chairing, agenda, information flow).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for disciplinary cultures
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of contents item: 'On disciplinary cultures'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation criteria and norms differ across disciplines; reviewers should be sensitive to disciplinary standards, methodologies, and what counts as excellence within a given field rather than applying uniform criteria across disciplines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply pragmatic fairness via customary rules of deliberation
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of contents item: 'Pragmatic fairness : customary rules of deliberation'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use customary, pragmatic deliberative rules and procedures (e.g., ordering of speakers, norms for argumentation, conflict resolution) to promote fair and consistent outcomes in committee decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize various kinds of excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of contents item: 'Recognizing various kinds of excellence.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value multiple forms of scholarly excellence (e.g., theoretical contribution, methodological rigor, applied impact, teaching, service) and avoid conflating one type of achievement with overall merit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider interdisciplinarity and diversity in evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of contents item: 'Considering interdisciplinarity and diversity.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess interdisciplinary work and contributions from diverse backgrounds with appropriate standards—avoid penalizing candidates for crossing boundaries or for differences rooted in institutional, cultural, or demographic diversity; adapt criteria to capture cross-cutting strengths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attend to national and international context and implications
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of contents item: 'Implications in the United States and abroad.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that institutional structures, evaluation norms, and expectations vary by country; evaluative practices and recommendations should be contextualized to national and international settings.
